keyProjects.title: NextCart
keyProjects.description: Bilingual (English/Bangla) POS and business-management app for shops, with an online store, inventory, finance, and multi-channel inbox
features: Single-backend architecture with a repository layer over a shared API service, bearer-token sessions scoped to a business, and secure credential storage
POS, products and bulk CSV upload, inventory, customers, vendors, employees, finance, sales reports, and cross-shop product sourcing
Online-shop controls, subscription tiers with payment flow, theme purchases, Firebase push notifications, and a unified WhatsApp/Instagram/Facebook inbox module
CI-checked codebase: provider-based state across ~20 providers, lint gates, and a growing test suite; multi-platform: Android, Web, and Windows

keyProjects.title: Gram Adalat
keyProjects.description: Legacy educational mobile application democratizing legal literacy regarding the Bangladesh Village Court Act for rural communities
features: Maintained and optimized a production Play Store application for legal literacy
Text-to-Speech pipelines for visually impaired or illiterate users
High-contrast UI layouts optimized for color-blind readability

keyProjects.title: MotoHealth
keyProjects.description: Private, local-first Flutter app for tracking everything about a motorcycle, live on Google Play
features: Pure, unit-tested logic for odometer estimation, full-tank mileage, due-date maintenance countdowns, and a bike-health score
Atomic JSON file persistence with backup recovery, plus local notifications rebuilt from data before papers expire or jobs fall due
Optional AI (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) that only selects jobs from a built-in maintenance catalog, validated and reviewed by the rider before applying; keys kept in secure storage
Automated Google Play releases via GitHub Actions, with architecture layering enforced by tests

keyProjects.title: Asset Management System
keyProjects.description: Field-ready Flutter app for on-site asset tracking with QR and UHF RFID scanning and checklist-driven inspections
features: Offline-first data layer with sqflite caching and queued checklist submissions
QR and UHF RFID scanning with photo capture and REST API sync
Scalable Riverpod architecture with EN/BN localization and volunteer/admin roles

keyProjects.title: Deadshot
keyProjects.description: Real-time squad coordination and group chat app for a Valorant friend group with daily 5-stack signup flow
features: Shared chatroom with message bubbles, reactions, yes/no polls, and unread badges
Flutter Riverpod providers with Firestore transactions and presence tracking
Firebase Auth, FCM push notifications via Cloud Functions, and cross-platform local notifications
